learning_outcomes.text: Acquaint the students with the application of computer as a technical device.
Acquaint the students with the different kinds of application of programming products for special electrical drawing and schemes AutoCAD.
Acquire the skills of independent elaboration and comprehension of design documents with application of special programming products and computer.

syllabus_topics: CAD Systems specifically programming products for electrical drawings.
General requirements for the preparation of technical documents.
Text documents, electrical schemes etc., rules for working out and reading.
Symbols for expressing specific details from the electrical industry.
Making draft symbols of electrical elements.
Use of programming products for electrical drawings with application of computer.
assessment_rules: The final mark is formed from the results of the course work and two control works. Assessment is continuous.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Electrical Power Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS FEEA (datos antiguos; ver notas)
